PROPOSED CANON BLOCK SHAPE for canon/personas.json:
personas.<persona_id>.presets : Preset[]
where Preset = {
id:           string  — stable snake_case id, globally unique within the persona
label:        string  — human display label (sentence case)
description:  string  — one-sentence intent
badges:       string[] — subset of canon/badges.json badge ids
is_default:   boolean? — exactly one preset per persona may carry true; UI seeds new users on this preset
Example (super_admin) would land at canon/personas.json#personas.super_admin.presets:
{ id: 'super_admin_full',     label: 'Full', description: '...', badges: [...], is_default: true },
{ id: 'super_admin_readonly', label: 'Read-only', description: '...', badges: [...] }
MIGRATION:
1. Move each persona's preset[] from this fixture into canon/personas.json under personas.<persona>.presets.
2. Bump canon/_version (ISO date + tag).
3. Run scripts/sync-canon-into-apps.sh.
4. Replace src/fixtures/persona-presets.json reads with canon reads in
src/lib/super-admin-storage.js (listPresets) and
src/personas/super/UserDirectory.jsx (preset dropdown).
5. Delete this fixture.
OPEN QUESTIONS for product:
- Should presets cascade: e.g. an Apex 'agent_lead' preset overrides the canon 'agent_lead' for org 102 only? Today flat: one preset list per persona, applies platform-wide.
- Should removed_badges live on the preset or stay user-level only? Today: presets are additive-only (a badge subset); per-user added/removed overrides remain on the user record.
- Should the 'consumer' persona have presets? Today: omitted (consumers don't sit in mc UserDirectory).
_comment: Fixture for Wave 19 Task 6 super-admin User Directory. Each persona gets 2-3 named presets that bundle a subset of the persona's full canon permissions. UI: when an admin assigns a user to a persona, they pick a preset from a dropdown; the preset determines which permissions get applied. Badge ids must exist in canon/badges.json. See _CANON_TODO above for promotion plan.
